name: DatePicker
description: Date field with a calendar popover. Typing and picking both work, in the user's locale.

errorMessage.description: Shown when the field is invalid.

granularity.description: Smallest editable unit. hour/minute add time segments.

isDisabled.description: Prevents editing and dims the field.

isInvalid.description: Marks the value invalid and shows errorMessage.

isRequired.description: Requires a date for form submission.

keyboard: Up/Down arrows change the focused segment
Alt+Down opens the calendar, Esc closes it
requirements: Label names the group and each segment
Segment order follows the user's locale
screenReader: The group is announced with its label; each segment with its name and value (month, 3) or as empty
Up/Down arrows announce each new value
The calendar button is announced as Calendar
After picking a date in the calendar, the new date is announced and focus is back in the field

use_when: Entering a single date, like a due date or birthday
avoid_when: A start and end date: use DateRangePicker
anti_patterns: A plain text input with a format hint like DD/MM/YYYY
Forcing calendar clicks for far-away dates like birthdays

Passing isInvalid for required or format checks (even isInvalid={false}): any defined value takes over validity and hides the built-in errors. Use isRequired and validate; pass isInvalid only for errors the app finds itself, such as from the server
